title: Dawang Village at the edge of the Dead Swamp
summary: Yu Yangzi, master of the Longevity Hall, kneels before his ancestors and prays that the treasure will restore his failing hall. At Dawang Village, beside the Dead Swamp, Xiao Yicai and the Qingyun disciples arrive to help Fa Xiang drive off Demon Sect fighters. Zhou Yixian and Xiao Huan set up a fortune-telling stall; Qin Wuyan of the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect poisons Longevity Hall thugs who try to chase them off, then has Xiao Huan read the names Qin and Gui Li. Ye Gou Daoren, angry at his own reading, has his money stolen by the grey monkey Xiao Hui, which gives it to Xiao Huan. Jin Ping'er of the He Huan Sect meets Xiao Huan as an old friend, then joins Gui Li and Qin Wuyan and accuses the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect of killing one of her disciples. In the rain Gui Li gives Xiao Huan his umbrella and insists he is a bad man, then saves her from a fish-man of the Shiwan Mountains. The Longevity Hall reports to Yu Yangzi that the three young masters have taken the bait and entered the swamp without their men.

672-679 s: a woman tells Xiao Huan 'after three years you still like candied gourds' and Xiao Huan calls her 'sister'. EP30 (962 s) has Xiao Huan ask after 'sister Ping'er', so this is read as Jin Ping'er; the donghua makes them old friends.
735 s 'Peri Jin' (Fairy Jin) = Jin Ping'er. The two men with her are read as Qin Wuyan and Gui Li (the 'three young masters' of 1047 s).
495-498 s 'Tuan Muda Xue', 'Tuan Muda Du' are unclear; dropped.
541 s 'Dewa Racun Senior' (Senior Poison God) read as Qin Wuyan's master.
1007.7 s 'Situs Kecil' is garbled, probably 'Xiao Huan'.
1010 s: Zhou Yixian says to avoid 'those two' in future; who exactly is meant is unclear.
